name: Elementor
description_en:
Elementor is a visual website-building plugin for WordPress, with a free open-source editor and paid Pro capabilities. It edits pages and reusable design structures inside a WordPress installation; advanced plans extend theme layouts, dynamic content, forms, popups and WooCommerce design. Elementor One bundles Editor Pro with credit-metered connected services, while Elementor Host is a separate hosting offer.

Choose the WordPress operating environment, site allowance and exact feature tier before buying. A plugin subscription does not pay for hosting, domain registration, WooCommerce payment processing or unlimited AI services. Existing theme/plugin compatibility, email delivery, responsive layouts and business-critical flows need testing on the actual site.
description_zh:
Elementor 是 WordPress 可视化建站插件，提供免费开源编辑器及付费 Pro 能力。它在 WordPress 安装中编辑页面和可复用设计结构；高级方案扩展主题布局、动态内容、表单、弹窗和 WooCommerce 设计。Elementor One 将 Editor Pro 与按额度计量的连接服务打包，Elementor Host 则是独立托管产品。

购买前应确认 WordPress 运行环境、站点名额和具体功能档。插件订阅不包含托管、域名注册、WooCommerce 支付处理或无限 AI 服务，实际站点仍需验证主题/插件兼容性、邮件发送、响应式布局和关键业务流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Install and activate the plugin in WordPress, then use Edit with Elementor to compose pages from widgets and design controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在 WordPress 安装并启用插件，再用 Edit with Elementor 通过组件和设计控制组合页面。

core_features.name_zh: 按方案开放的 Pro 设计工具
core_features.explanation_en: Essential includes Theme Builder but excludes popup/custom CSS/eCommerce features; Advanced Solo and higher listed tiers add those tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: Essential 包含 Theme Builder，但不含弹窗/自定义 CSS/电商能力；Advanced Solo 及所列更高方案增加这些工具。

core_features.explanation_en: One includes 25,000 monthly credits for connected services; unused credits do not roll over and action costs vary. Editor Pro itself consumes no credits.
core_features.explanation_zh: One 每月含 25,000 连接服务额度，未用额度不结转，操作消耗不同；Editor Pro 本身不消耗额度。

pricing.summary_en: Free open-source WordPress editor; rendered annual Pro charges $60 Essential/$84 Advanced Solo/$108 Advanced. One displayed $180 first annual charge, $228 renewal, plus metered services; hosting separate. Currency/tax checkout confirmation required.

sections.title_en: Begin with a compatible WordPress site
sections.title_zh: 从兼容的 WordPress 站点开始
sections.en:
The plugin’s current installation section lists WordPress 6.8+, PHP 7.4+, MySQL 5.6 or MariaDB 10.5+, and 256 MB PHP/WordPress memory minimums, with higher recommendations. Extra plugins can raise resource requirements. Install via WordPress Plugins, activate, create a page and choose Edit with Elementor. Use a staging copy to check theme and plugin combinations before changing a live site. The directory says standards-compliant themes are supported and recommends Hello, but that statement is not proof that a specific existing stack is compatible.

Primary evidence: [Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/).
sections.zh:
插件当前安装章节列出最低 WordPress 6.8、PHP 7.4、MySQL 5.6 或 MariaDB 10.5，以及 PHP/WordPress 各 256 MB 内存，并有更高推荐配置；额外插件可能提高资源需求。通过 WordPress Plugins 安装并启用，创建页面后选择 Edit with Elementor。修改线上站点前，应使用暂存副本验证主题和插件组合。目录称支持符合 WordPress 标准的主题并推荐 Hello，但不能由此证明某个既有技术栈兼容。

一手依据：[Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/)。

sections.title_en: Buy the tier required by the page behavior
sections.title_zh: 按页面行为选择功能档
sections.en:
The official table gives Essential one site, 57 Pro widgets and 10 cloud templates. Its Dynamic Content excludes custom fields/post types, and its Form Builder excludes submission management; popup, custom code/CSS, eCommerce features and collaborative notes are absent. Advanced Solo covers one site with the broader 85-widget set, dynamic custom fields/post types, submission management and the excluded tools; Advanced covers three sites and Expert lists 25. Test a real lead form and store template before choosing. A WooCommerce design tool does not replace product, tax, inventory, payment-provider or fulfillment configuration.

Primary evidence: [Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/).
sections.zh:
官方表中 Essential 含一个站点、57 个 Pro 组件和 10 个云模板；动态内容不含自定义字段/文章类型，表单构建不含提交管理，也不含弹窗、自定义代码/CSS、电商功能和协作注释。Advanced Solo 含一个站点、85 组件、更完整动态字段/文章类型、提交管理及前述工具；Advanced 覆盖三个站点，Expert 列 25 个。选择前应用真实获客表单和商店模板验证。WooCommerce 设计工具不能替代商品、税费、库存、支付服务商及履约设置。

一手依据：[Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/)。

sections.title_en: Read annual charge and renewal separately
sections.title_zh: 分开读取年付金额与续费
sections.en: The normal browser view displayed Essential $5/month equivalent billed $60 annually, Advanced Solo $7 equivalent/$84 annually and Advanced $9 equivalent/$108 annually. One displayed $15 equivalent/$180 today, renewing at $228/year. These are observed dollar displays; confirm the currency selection, taxes and account-specific promotion at checkout instead of deriving a universal local price. The page limits the 30-day money-back guarantee to annual plans. The static text omitted numeric amounts, so this draft attaches the rendered browser receipt alongside the feature table. Expert and One Agency prices were not read in their selected browser states.
sections.zh: 正常浏览器视图显示 Essential 月均 $5、年付 $60；Advanced Solo 月均 $7、年付 $84；Advanced 月均 $9、年付 $108。One 显示月均 $15、当次 $180，续费 $228/年。这是实读美元符号显示，需在结账确认货币选择、税费及账户活动，不能推导通用本地报价。页面将 30 天退款保证限定为年付方案。静态文本没有金额，因此本草稿将渲染浏览器记录与功能表共同引用。未读取 Expert 和 One Agency 被选中状态下的价格。

sections.en: One lists one site and 25,000 monthly credits; One Agency lists unlimited sites and 350,000 shared monthly credits. The FAQ says Editor Pro and accessibility scans use zero credits, while an accessibility AI fix costs 20, an optimized image 10, an email delivery 10, and cookie consent or a cookie scan 1; AI actions vary from 1–40. Consumption can change for existing plans. Credits reset monthly without rollover; the documented exhaustion options are waiting for replenishment or upgrading. Most importantly, the expanded FAQ explicitly says One does not include hosting and can run on a compatible WordPress provider. Compare Host separately rather than adding it implicitly to this subscription.
sections.zh: One 列出一个站点和每月 25,000 额度；One Agency 列出不限站点和 350,000 共享月额度。FAQ 称 Editor Pro 和无障碍扫描不消耗额度，AI 无障碍修复每次 20、图片优化每张 10、邮件每封 10，cookie 同意或扫描各 1，AI 操作为 1–40，且消耗规则可对既有方案改变。额度每月重置、不结转，用尽后文档列出的选择是等待补充或升级。展开 FAQ 明确 One 不含托管，可在兼容 WordPress 服务商运行，应独立比较 Host，不能将托管隐含加入订阅。

sections.title_zh: 开源编辑器与服务权利
sections.en:
The official Terms of Service explicitly licenses both Elementor and Elementor Pro software under GPLv3 while reserving rights in the separate online store, templates and services. WordPress.org identifies the free Elementor plugin as open-source software, and the official public repository’s license.txt contains GNU GPL version 3. This supports classifying the free editor’s source as copyleft open source. It does not establish that premium cloud services, paid support, every asset or every bundled product can be used without their own subscription terms. Operating the plugin on your own WordPress hosting still requires server maintenance, backups, security and compatible updates. These sources do not prove that uninstalling Elementor preserves all page layouts or that a static export includes dynamic store/forms behavior; test the intended migration before relying on it.

Primary evidence: [Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/).

Primary evidence: [GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE — Version 3, 29 June 2007](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elementor/elementor/main/license.txt).
sections.zh:
官方服务条款明确 Elementor 与 Elementor Pro 软件均采用 GPLv3，同时对独立网店、模板及服务保留权利。WordPress.org 将免费 Elementor 插件标为开源软件，官方公开仓库 license.txt 为 GNU GPL 第 3 版，因此可将免费编辑器源码归为 copyleft 开源。这不证明高级云服务、付费支持、全部素材或每个打包产品可以脱离订阅条款使用。在自己的 WordPress 托管环境运行插件，仍需维护服务器、备份、安全和兼容更新。这些来源不证明卸载 Elementor 后全部布局保留，或静态导出可保留动态商店/表单；依赖迁移方案前应实际验证。

一手依据：[Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/)。

一手依据：[GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE — Version 3, 29 June 2007](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elementor/elementor/main/license.txt)。

sections.title_en: Evaluate one page, one form and one update cycle
sections.title_zh: 验证页面、表单和更新周期
sections.en:
Elementor is a plausible fit for a WordPress team that wants visual page control and is willing to operate that ecosystem. Build a representative page, adjust global styles, inspect mobile breakpoints, verify the lead destination and email delivery, and exercise any WooCommerce checkout before publishing. For AI-generated structures or code, inspect the generated result and permission scope rather than assuming production readiness from vendor wording. A team seeking a standalone non-WordPress app or maintenance-free hosting should evaluate those needs separately. No installation, MCP connection, generation, payment, compatibility benchmark or migration was executed in this research.

Primary evidence: [Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/).
sections.zh:
希望可视化控制页面、也愿意维护 WordPress 生态的团队可考虑 Elementor。应构建代表性页面、调整全局样式、检查手机断点，验证线索目的地及邮件发送，并测试 WooCommerce 结账后再发布。对于 AI 生成结构或代码，应检查结果和权限范围，不能仅凭厂商“生产可用”文案接受。需要独立非 WordPress 应用或无需维护托管的团队应另行评估这些需求。本次未执行安装、MCP 连接、生成、支付、兼容性基准或迁移。

一手依据：[Elementor Website Builder – more than just a page builder – WordPress plugin | WordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgWordPress.orgCode is Poetry](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elementor/)。
